name: Mr. Jignesh Mehta
bio: Mr. Jignesh Mehta is the visionary leader behind Quantum Overseas, with over 15 years of rich experience in foreign education consulting, immigration policy, and global partnerships. He has personally guided thousands of students and families to successfully settle across the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.

name: Mr. Sahil Shelat
bio: Mr. Sahil Shelat specializes in PR pathways, Express Entry, PNP provincial nominations, and work permit documentation. His analytical approach and detailed knowledge of immigration regulations ensure highest success rates for complex cases.

name: Mr. Ankur Shah
bio: Mr. Ankur Shah oversees student university applications, scholarship acquisition, and SOP evaluations. He has established direct associations with premier global universities to expedite offer letters and visa approvals.

name: Mr. Chintan Kothari
bio: Mr. Chintan Kothari is an expert in visa compliance, consular documentation, financial verification, and interview preparation, helping clients navigate stringent embassy requirements with ease.

name: Alextina Ditarson
bio: Devid Miller coordinates corporate partnerships, international student welfare, and investor visa programs across North America and Europe.
